name: mockk
description: Mocking library for Kotlin. Use only for tag-gated Kotlin object seams; do not mix with Mockito in the same test file.
source_confidence: high for coordinates and primary public APIs used by UnitTest_gen MockK lane.

packages.name: io.mockk
packages.purpose: Kotlin-first mocking DSL for classes, objects, and statics.

functions.name: mockkObject
signature_patterns: fun mockkObject(vararg objects: Any, recordPrivateCalls: Boolean = false)
functions.purpose: Replace Kotlin object singletons with mocks for the current test scope.

functions.name: unmockkObject
signature_patterns: fun unmockkObject(vararg objects: Any)

functions.name: mockkConstructor
signature_patterns: fun mockkConstructor(vararg classes: KClass<*>, recordPrivateCalls: Boolean = false)
functions.purpose: Intercept Java/Kotlin constructors when SOURCE does Type(args). Use with anyConstructed; not a substitute for mockkStatic.

functions.name: unmockkConstructor
signature_patterns: fun unmockkConstructor(vararg classes: KClass<*>)
functions.purpose: Clear constructor mocks opened with mockkConstructor.

functions.name: anyConstructed
signature_patterns: inline fun <reified T : Any> anyConstructed(): T
functions.purpose: Stub or verify members on instances created after mockkConstructor(T::class).

functions.name: mockkStatic
signature_patterns: fun mockkStatic(vararg classes: KClass<*>)
fun mockkStatic(vararg functions: String)
functions.purpose: Mock static/Java @JvmStatic or top-level functions when the MockK-only lane also needs static seams (for example CarUi).

functions.name: unmockkStatic
signature_patterns: fun unmockkStatic(vararg classes: KClass<*>)
fun unmockkStatic(vararg functions: String)
functions.purpose: Clear static mocks opened with mockkStatic.

functions.name: unmockkAll
signature_patterns: fun unmockkAll()
functions.purpose: Clear all MockK object/static/constructor mocks; prefer in @After teardown.

functions.name: mockk
signature_patterns: inline fun <reified T : Any> mockk(name: String? = null, relaxed: Boolean = false, ...): T
functions.purpose: Create a MockK mock instance for constructor/collaborator dependencies in the MockK-only lane.

functions.name: every
signature_patterns: fun <T> every(stubBlock: MockKMatcherScope.() -> T): MockKStubScope<T, T>
functions.purpose: Stub a call on a mock or mocked object.

functions.name: coEvery
signature_patterns: fun <T> coEvery(stubBlock: suspend MockKMatcherScope.() -> T): MockKStubScope<T, T>

functions.name: verify
signature_patterns: fun verify(ordering: Ordering = Ordering.UNORDERED, ..., verifyBlock: MockKVerificationScope.() -> Unit)
functions.purpose: Verify calls on mocks or mocked objects.

functions.name: coVerify
signature_patterns: fun coVerify(ordering: Ordering = Ordering.UNORDERED, ..., verifyBlock: suspend MockKVerificationScope.() -> Unit)

functions.name: just
signature_patterns: infix fun MockKStubScope<Unit, *>.just(runs: Runs)
functions.purpose: Complete a Unit-returning stub with just Runs.

functions.name: Runs
signature_patterns: object Runs
functions.purpose: Marker used with just Runs for void/Unit stubs.

functions.name: any
signature_patterns: inline fun <reified T : Any> MockKMatcherScope.any(): T
functions.purpose: Typed argument matcher for MockK stubs and verifies.

functions.name: slot
signature_patterns: inline fun <reified T : Any> slot(): CapturingSlot<T>
functions.purpose: Capture arguments with slot/capture in MockK verifies.

functions.name: capture
signature_patterns: inline fun <reified T : Any> MockKMatcherScope.capture(slot: CapturingSlot<T>): T
functions.purpose: Capture a matching argument into a CapturingSlot.

functions.name: clearMocks
signature_patterns: fun clearMocks(firstMock: Any, vararg mocks: Any, answers: Boolean = true, recordedCalls: Boolean = true, childMocks: Boolean = true, verificationMarks: Boolean = true, exclusionRules: Boolean = true)
functions.purpose: Clear recorded calls/answers between tests without unmocking objects.
